name: flow-view-monorepo
description: flow_view — see what your code does while it runs

scripts.test:py: PYTHONPATH=packages/trace-schema/python:adapters/python python3 -m pytest packages/trace-schema/python/tests adapters/python/tests apps/server/tests conformance/tests -q
scripts.verify: pnpm schema:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:py && pnpm conformance && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @flow-view/web build
